facts.fact: On 31 July 2025 the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation launched the formulation of the National AI Strategy, with working groups created to draft inputs for its thematic chapters.

facts.fact: The document says the Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029 was launched in May 2025, setting out the country's vision to use AI for growth and service delivery; it does not say who adopted it.
The Digital Transformation Blueprint is named as covering 2025 to 2029.

MUS.note: A nationwide public consultation is only announced as coming soon; none shown to have run online.

facts.fact: The ministry's first industry kick-off meeting on the National AI Strategy on 31 July 2025 brought together government, industry (including Business Mauritius and telecom operators), academia and civil society, and an Industry Working Group chaired by Business Mauritius's CEO was appointed.
